Nephilim.text: This card also counts as a Light card, for any card that asks for one.
Nephilim.why: Robert (V45): no Neutral cards at all, so there is no in-between rule to teach. Nephilim is Dark and, for card abilities, Light too; it pushes and scores as Dark

Twilight.text: At the end of the Day: If the other cards in your Choir hold as many Light cards as Dark cards (at least 1 each), gain 2 Glory.
Twilight.why: Robert (V45): no Neutral cards. Twilight is Light

Acolyte.text: This card's color matches the most recent Day won: Light after a Light Day, Dark after a Dark Day. Before any Day is won, it is Light.
Acolyte.why: Robert (V45): no Neutral cards. Acolyte is never Neutral: it keeps the last winner's color
